name: Block Corrupt
description: Random block glyphs corrupt the text over time.
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ var bl="░▒▓█",t=el.text,o=""; for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){ var c=t.charAt(i); if(c===" "){o+=c;continue;} var r=(AM.simplexNoise(i*5.1,p.seed+Math.floor(env.absTime*p.speed))+1)/2; o+= r<p.amount ? bl.charAt(Math.floor(r*100)%4) : c; } el.text=o; return el; }
